rationale: The strongest of the supplied translations for readability and semantic fidelity, although unnecessary English terminology remains a localization weakness. It preserves all six H2 headings, zero headings at other levels, four images and figure captions, and the unchanged text code block; its relative asset paths resolve correctly. There are no same-page heading links, quizzes, Challenges, tables, blockquotes, component imports, or answer flags requiring reconciliation. The Gemini candidate has additional mistranslations and an untranslated closing line; the Haiku candidate retains substantially more English and incorrectly implies that the curves' product does not grow. Only three candidate bodies were supplied, and neither judge report was included, so this selection is based on direct comparison of the available MDX.
